Title: Update delivery
Exit: pacer update, the once-only notice and scripts/release.py are verified in both hosts

Title: Display
Produce: Render every long operation as a journey under the Pace Line, with a plain fallback off a terminal

Title: Lineage
Produce: Carry the MIVIM hierarchy in the runtime identity, the user-level home and the kit

Title: Update engine
Produce: Advance the source, sync each host only when its copy differs, and keep the command editable

Title: Notice
Produce: Announce a new version once, with the update and silence commands, in the terminal and in agent sessions

Title: Release automation
Produce: Ship a release from one command: version, checks, kit, proof, commit, tag, push, sync

Title: Record
Produce: Record the decisions and the live trials; update the format reference, READMEs and changelog

Title: Human CLI
Exit: update, init and doctor carry a human layer verified in a terminal and under the tests

Title: Prompts
Produce: Raw keys from the console, a chooser on rails and a path field with a live scan; each returns its default off a terminal
Probe: uv run --no-project --python ">=3.11" scripts/check.py --tests "prompt or keys or display"

Title: Update asks where
Produce: pacer update with --claude, --codex and --all; without a flag it asks where in a terminal and takes every host off one

Title: Init wires a host
Produce: pacer init [path] --claude or --codex: .pacer/ plus the host enrolled; prompts for what is missing in a terminal; JSON stays for agents

Title: Doctor
Produce: pacer doctor: vitals of machine, hosts and project in one panel; --fix applies the repairs it owns and names the command for the rest

Title: Record
Produce: Design decisions, a live trial in both hosts, README, plugin README, format reference, AGENTS.md commands and the 3.2.0 changelog section
